plan.name: NewHubEvent

result.detail: NOT CLI-TESTABLE - webhook trigger. The CLI starts the component lifecycle and blocks; test() throws by design. Covered by the E2E flow "E2E HubBI - receive hub" instead: with the flow running, the payload HubBI would send was POSTed to /flows/{flowId}/components/{componentId} and the assert passed ("E2E Widget is not empty"). That verifies the connector's half - webhook handling, conversionKey filtering, record normalization, object output mode. HubBI's own delivery still needs the manual registration described in artifacts/test-flows/README.md.

plan.note: Not testable via the CLI: webhook trigger with no in port, and test() throws by design (HubBI has no endpoint for past events). Verified via the E2E flow with a direct webhook probe.

plan.note: Generic call-any-endpoint component required by the repo standard (issue #1459).

result.detail: PASS - GET /Flows/Home/ListTargetHubs returned 200 with the hub list, clientKey injected automatically. The parameters/headers inputs cannot be driven through the CLI: the standard declares their schema type as "string" while the key-value inspector produces an array, and port validation rejects it - the reference implementation (fal) fails identically. Those paths are covered by unit tests.
